Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12311 of 2023
Applicant :- Harish Chandra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Irshad Ahmad

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in complaint No. 510/2014, under Sections 376(D) IPC, police station Dilari, District Moradabad with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

It was submitted that the prosecutrix has lodged the complaint of this case against applicant and co-accused Amit, Monu and Yogesh, alleging that she was the complainant of an earlier case crime no. 464/2013 and that accused persons were threatening her for compromise in that case and on 23.02.2014 all the four accused persons forcibly took her to a sugarcane field and committed rape upon her.

Learned counsel submitted that applicant is not an Harish Chandra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126194263/
1 accused in the above-stated case crime no. 464/2013 and thus, he has no motive to indulge in the alleged incident.

sentences.text: The allegations made by the complainant are thoroughly improbable.
Alleged incident has been shown of 23.02.2014, but after the incident, no FIR was lodged and after about two months of the incident, the prosecutrix has lodged this complaint case.
She is a mature and married lady, aged about 36 years.
There is no medical examination report of the prosecutrix to support her allegations.

Referring to the facts of the matter, it was submitted that the allegations of rape made against the applicant are thoroughly false and improbable and that applicant has been summoned in a complaint case.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 15.01.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, facts of the case, nature of allegations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant Harish Chandra involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
1. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
2. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
3. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
